entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_adjust_brightness_contrast
entries.description:
Adjust brightness and contrast of the active layer.

Users often say: fix exposure, add contrast, brighten, darken.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_adjust_curves
entries.description:
Create a Curves adjustment layer on the active document.

Users often say: make it pop, S-curve, fix flat image, auto tone, improve contrast.

Use when: global tonal correction via a non-destructive Curves adjustment layer.
Do NOT use when: stylistic cinematic grade — use photoshop_recipe_apply_color_grade.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, preset } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds Curves adjustment layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_adjust_exposure
entries.description:
Create an Exposure adjustment layer (stops, offset, gamma correction).

Users often say: fix underexposed photo, brighten by a stop, gamma fix.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, exposure, offset, gamma } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds an Exposure adjustment layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_adjust_hue_saturation
entries.description: Adjust hue, saturation, and lightness of the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_adjust_vibrance
entries.description:
Create a Vibrance adjustment layer. Vibrance boosts muted colors while protecting skin tones.

Users often say: make colors pop (safely), boost saturation without clown look.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, vibrance, saturation } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds a Vibrance adjustment layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_gaussian_blur
entries.description: Apply Gaussian Blur filter to the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_gradient_map
entries.description:
Create a Gradient Map adjustment layer (black→white by default) for duotone/B&W tonal remapping.

Users often say: duotone look, gradient map B&W, remap tones.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, reverse } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds a Gradient Map adjustment layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_gradient_mask
entries.description:
Apply a linear black-to-white gradient on the active layer mask channel (fade/blend).

Users often say: fade into background, gradient mask, blend subject, soft edge fade.

This paints on an existing layer mask — not a Gradient Fill layer.
Use when: softening edges or fading a layer into the background through its mask.
Do NOT use when: subject is not isolated — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background or photoshop_create_layer_mask first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { applied, direction, angle, mask_auto_created? } }.
Preconditions: active document and active layer. Creates a reveal-all mask if none exists.
Side effects: modifies layer mask pixels; two history steps when mask is auto-created.

direction.description: Gradient fade direction on the mask (default bottom_to_top)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_high_pass
entries.description:
Apply the High Pass filter to the active raster layer — edge/detail extraction for sharpening workflows or frequency separation prep.

Users often say: high pass filter, sharpen edges, extract details, frequency separation high layer.

Use when: sharpening via overlay blend, detail extraction, or prepping a high-frequency layer.
Do NOT use on text, Smart Objects, or the Background layer — rasterize or convert first (photoshop_rasterize_layer).

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { filter, radius, context } }.
Preconditions: active document; normal (raster) layer selected. Side effects: one history step.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_layer_mask
entries.description: Apply (merge) the layer mask to the layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_layer_style
entries.description:
Apply a layer style (drop shadow, outer glow, stroke, bevel & emboss) to the active layer via Action Manager layer effects.

Users often say: add shadow, glow effect, outline this layer, stroke, bevel, 3D button look, katmana gölge ver.

Use when: quick presentational effects on the active layer (cards, buttons, mockups, text pop).
Do NOT use when: you need full custom layer-effects control — use photoshop_execute_script with a custom layerEffects descriptor.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { style, layer_name } }.
Preconditions: active document with an active pixel/text layer. Side effects: sets the chosen effect on the active layer.

size.description: Blur/size in pixels (stroke width for stroke)

distance.description: Offset distance in pixels (drop shadow only)

angle.description: Light angle in degrees (drop shadow / bevel)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_lut
entries.description:
Apply a Color Lookup (3D LUT) adjustment layer for cinematic color grading. Accepts a built-in LUT name (e.g. "Crisp_Warm.3dl", "Kodak 5218 Fuji 3510.3dl", "Moonlight.3dl") or an absolute path to a .cube/.3dl/.look file.

Users often say: cinematic grade, film look, teal and orange, apply LUT, sinematik renk.

Use when: stylistic non-destructive color grade in one step.
Do NOT use when: basic tonal fixes — use photoshop_adjust_curves or photoshop_auto_levels.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, lut, lut_source } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds a Color Lookup adjustment layer.

lut.description: Built-in LUT file name (e.g. "Crisp_Warm.3dl") or absolute path to a .cube/.3dl/.look file

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_motion_blur
entries.description: Apply Motion Blur filter to the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_noise
entries.description: Apply Add Noise filter to the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_photo_filter
entries.description:
Create a Photo Filter adjustment layer (warming/cooling/custom tint with density control).

Users often say: warm it up, cool it down, add a tint, golden hour look.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, color, density } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds a Photo Filter adjustment layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_sharpen
entries.description: Apply Unsharp Mask (sharpen) filter to the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_apply_smart_blur
entries.description:
Apply the Smart Blur filter to the active raster layer — edge-preserving blur for smoothing skin or simplifying backgrounds.

Users often say: smart blur, edge-preserving blur, smooth skin blur, blur but keep edges.

Use when: subtle smoothing that respects edges (portraits, product cleanup).
Do NOT use on text, Smart Objects, or the Background layer — rasterize first (photoshop_rasterize_layer).
Do NOT use when: uniform blur is enough — use photoshop_apply_gaussian_blur.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { filter, radius, threshold, mode, quality, context } }.
Preconditions: active document; normal (raster) layer selected. Side effects: one history step.

threshold.description: Blur threshold — higher values restrict blur to stronger edges (0.1-100)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_auto_contrast
entries.description: Apply auto contrast adjustment to the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_auto_levels
entries.description:
Apply auto levels adjustment to the active layer.

Users often say: fix flat image, auto tone, make it pop (mild).

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_close_document
entries.description: Close the active Photoshop document

save.description: Whether to save changes before closing

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_content_aware_fill
entries.description:
Fill the current pixel selection using Content-Aware Fill.

Users often say: remove distraction, erase object, content aware fill, inpaint selection.

Use when: a rectangular or other selection covers the area to remove/replace.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — use photoshop_select_rectangle first.
Do NOT use when: generative remove is requested — not scriptable; use this fill or manual touch-up.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { filled } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection.
Side effects: modifies pixels inside selection; deselects afterward.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_contract_selection
entries.description:
Contract (shrink) the active pixel selection inward by a pixel amount.

Use when: tightening a loose selection or trimming halo after expand.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create one first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { pixels, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: modifies selection.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_convert_to_smart_object
entries.description:
Convert the active layer (or a named layer) to an embedded Smart Object.

Users often say: convert to smart object, make smart layer, embed layer.

Use when: non-destructive transforms/filters are needed on a raster or shape layer.
Do NOT use when: the layer is already a Smart Object — returns success with already_smart_object.
Do NOT use on background layers — unlock or duplicate first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, kind, already_smart_object? } }.
Preconditions: active document; target layer must be selected or named. Side effects: one history step.

layer_name.description: Optional exact layer name (recursive search). Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_clipping_mask
entries.description:
Create a clipping mask on the active layer (or a named layer).

Users often say: clip to layer below, clipping mask, clip this layer, mask to shape below.

Use when: the active layer should be visible only where the layer directly below it has opaque pixels.
Do NOT use when: the layer is already clipped — returns success with already_clipping.
Do NOT use when: the layer is the bottom-most layer — there is no base layer to clip into.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, is_clipping, already_clipping? } }.
Preconditions: active document; target layer must sit directly above the base layer below it in the same group/stack.
Side effects: one history step (groupEvent).

layer_name.description: Optional exact layer name (recursive search). Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_document
entries.description:
Create a new empty Photoshop document with specified dimensions and color mode.

Use when: starting a design from scratch or no document is open.
Do NOT use when: opening an existing file — use photoshop_open_image.

Returns: created document id and name.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: creates a new document and makes it active.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_layer
entries.description:
Create a new empty layer above the active layer.

Use when: user needs a blank layer for painting, fills, or stacking content.
Do NOT use when: adding text — use photoshop_create_text_layer.

Returns: created layer name and context.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds layer to history.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_layer_mask
entries.description:
Create a layer mask on the active layer from the current selection (reveal selection).

Users often say: mask this, hide the background, non-destructive cutout (after selection).

Use when: non-destructive hide/show after a selection exists.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create selection first or use remove_background recipe.

Returns: maskCreated confirmation.
Preconditions: active document and active selection. Side effects: adds mask to active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_smart_object_via_copy
entries.description:
Create an independent Smart Object via Copy — unlinked duplicate with its own embedded contents.

Users often say: new smart object via copy, independent smart copy, duplicate smart object separately.

Use when: you need a second Smart Object that does not share embedded data with the original.
Do NOT use when: you want linked instances — use photoshop_duplicate_layer (Layer via Copy).

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { source_layer_name, new_layer_name, kind } }.
Preconditions: Smart Object layer active or named. Side effects: adds a new Smart Object layer.

layer_name.description: Optional source Smart Object layer name. Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_create_text_layer
entries.description:
Create a text layer with content, position, font size, and optional font.

Use when: adding labels, titles, or typography to the design.
Do NOT use when: editing existing text — use photoshop_update_text_content.

Returns: layer name, text, position, fontSize, font (when fontName set), context.
Use photoshop_list_fonts to discover font names; photoshop_set_text_font to change font later.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: adds text layer.

fontName.description: Optional font display or PostScript name (resolved via app.fonts; see photoshop_list_fonts)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_crop_document
entries.description: Crop the document to specified bounds

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_delete_layer
entries.description: Delete the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_delete_layer_mask
entries.description: Delete the layer mask from active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_desaturate
entries.description: Desaturate the active layer (convert to grayscale)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_deselect
entries.description: Deselect all selections

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_duplicate_layer
entries.description: Duplicate the active layer. The duplicate becomes the active layer; returns its name and, when available, its layer id.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_edit_smart_object_contents
entries.description:
Open a Smart Object for editing (double-click / Edit Contents). The embedded .psb becomes the active document until you save and close it.

Users often say: edit smart object, open embedded file, double-click smart layer.

Use when: modifying pixels inside an embedded Smart Object non-destructively.
Do NOT use when: replacing the whole asset — use photoshop_replace_smart_object_contents.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { parent_document, embedded_document, layer_name } }.
Preconditions: Smart Object layer active or named.
Side effects: active document switches to the embedded .psb — save/close it to return to the parent document.

layer_name.description: Optional exact Smart Object layer name. Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_execute_script
entries.description:
Execute custom ExtendScript (JSX) code inside Photoshop (advanced escape hatch).

Use when: no existing tool covers the operation and you can write safe JSX.
Do NOT use when: a recipe or atomic tool exists — prefer photoshop_recipe_* or photoshop_* tools.

Returns: script return value serialized as text/JSON.
IMPORTANT: Your code runs inside a wrapping IIFE. Use an explicit `return` to pass data back — a bare trailing expression returns undefined. Example: `return { ok: true };` Objects are serialized with toSource() and parsed automatically on macOS and Windows.
Preconditions: valid ExtendScript; active document if script expects one. Side effects: depends on code.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_expand_selection
entries.description:
Expand the active pixel selection outward by a pixel amount.

Use when: growing a tight subject selection or adding padding before feather/fill.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create one first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { pixels, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: modifies selection.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_export_as
entries.description:
Export a copy of the active document as PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF without changing the open document. WebP/AVIF require Photoshop 23.2+/recent builds and return a clear error when unsupported.

Users often say: export for web, save as webp, quick export png.

Use when: web-ready delivery formats are needed (WebP/AVIF/modern pipelines).
Do NOT use when: saving the working document itself — use photoshop_save_document.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { path, format, method } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: writes one file to path.

path.description: Absolute output file path (extension should match format)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_feather_selection
entries.description:
Feather (soften) the edges of the active pixel selection.

Use when: soft transitions before fill, mask, or delete operations.
Do NOT use when: a hard edge is required or no selection exists.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { pixels, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: modifies selection edges.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_fill_layer
entries.description: Fill the active layer with a color

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_fit_layer_to_document
entries.description: Scale the active layer to fit the document canvas while maintaining aspect ratio

fillDocument.description: If true, fills entire canvas (may crop). If false, fits within canvas (may have margins). Default: false

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_flatten_image
entries.description: Flatten all layers into a single background layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generate_from_datasets
entries.description:
Batch-export the active document once per data set: applies each data set, saves a copy, moves on. "Mail merge for images".

Users often say: generate all variants, batch personalize, render every row.

Use when: data sets are already imported (photoshop_import_datasets) and you want one file per row.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { exported, skipped, output_paths } }.
Preconditions: active document with data sets. Side effects: writes files to output_dir.

output_dir.description: Directory for generated files (created if missing)

dataset_names.description: Subset of data set names to export (default: all)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generate_image
entries.description:
Generate image content from a text prompt (text-to-image) on blank or active document.

Use when: creating new imagery from a description.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: generative_fill capability; Adobe generative credits.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generative_expand
entries.description:
Extend the canvas beyond its edges using Generative Expand (Firefly).

Use when: outpainting, extending background, or expanding composition.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { direction, prompt, wait } }.
Preconditions: active document; generative_fill capability.
Side effects: enlarges canvas with generated content.

prompt.description: Describe how to extend the image

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generative_fill
entries.description:
Fill the current selection using Adobe Generative Fill (Firefly) with a text prompt.

Use when: adding or replacing content inside a selection with generative AI.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create one first or use photoshop_select_subject.
Do NOT use when: Photoshop version lacks generative_fill — check photoshop_get_capabilities.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { action_id, prompt, wait } }.
Preconditions: PS 24+ with generative credits; active pixel selection.
Side effects: modifies pixels in selection; may consume Adobe generative credits.

prompt.description: Describe what to generate in the selection

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generative_remove
entries.description:
Remove content using the AI Remove tool (or generative fill fallback) on the current selection.

Use when: erasing distractions, people, or objects with generative AI.
Do NOT use when: generative unavailable — fallback to photoshop_recipe_remove_distraction.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: selection or auto_select_subject; generative_fill capability.
Side effects: inpaints selected region; consumes generative credits when cloud-backed.

auto_select_subject.description: Run Select Subject when no selection exists (default false)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_generative_upscale
entries.description:
Upscale the active document using Generative Upscale (PS 27+).

Use when: increasing resolution with AI detail recovery.
Do NOT use when: generative_upscale flag is false — use photoshop_resize_image.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: generative_upscale capability; signed-in Adobe account.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_capabilities
entries.description:
Return version-aware feature flags for the installed Photoshop (Select Subject v2, Generative Fill, etc.).

Use when: once per session before suggesting AI-powered features or gated recipes.
Do NOT use when: Photoshop version is already known from photoshop_get_version.

Returns: JSON { version, features: { select_subject_v2, generative_fill, ... } }.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_document_info
entries.description: Get information about the active Photoshop document

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_history
entries.description: Get the history states of the active document

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_layers
entries.description:
List all layers in the active document with kind, visibility, and opacity.

Use when: choosing a layer to edit, debugging structure, or after organize_layers.
Do NOT use when: only session summary is needed — use photoshop_get_state (lighter).

Returns: layerCount, layers array, context.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_preview
entries.description:
Export the active document as a base64 JPEG preview for visual verification.

Use when: after visual edits to confirm result before reporting success to the user.
Do NOT use when: you only need numeric state — use photoshop_get_state (much cheaper).

Returns: MCP image content block (JPEG) plus metadata text.
Preconditions: active document required. Side effects: creates and deletes a temp file; does not modify the document.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_selection_bounds
entries.description:
Read the active pixel selection bounds in document pixels (read-only).

Use when: verifying selection exists and its size/position before mask, fill, or recipe steps.
Do NOT use when: creating or modifying a selection — use photoshop_select_rectangle or photoshop_select_subject.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { has_selection, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_state
entries.description:
Return a cheap read-only snapshot of Photoshop session state (active document, layer, selection).

Use when: before any tool that needs an active document/layer, or after an error to recover context.
Do NOT use when: you only need a visual preview — use photoshop_get_preview instead.

Returns: JSON with hasDocument, document dimensions/colorMode, activeLayer kind/name, hasSelection.
Preconditions: none (safe on empty session). Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_get_version
entries.description:
Return the detected Photoshop version string.

Use when: user asks about compatibility or before version-gated features.
Do NOT use when: you need feature flags — prefer photoshop_get_capabilities.

Returns: version string.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_image_stack
entries.description:
Load 2+ image files into one document, convert to a smart object and apply a stack mode (mean/median/max/min/...). Classic "remove tourists from N shots" or noise reduction — no generative AI involved.

Users often say: remove tourists, median stack, average these photos, noise stack, turistleri sil.

Use when: the user has multiple aligned shots of the same scene and wants a statistical blend.
Do NOT use when: removing a single object from one photo — use photoshop_generative_remove or photoshop_content_aware_fill.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { file_count, mode, layer_name } }.
Preconditions: 2+ existing image files. Side effects: opens the files; the stacked result becomes the active document.

files.description: Absolute paths of the images to stack (min 2)

mode.description: Stack mode — median removes transient objects, mean reduces noise

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_import_datasets
entries.description:
Import a Photoshop variables/data-sets XML file into the active document (the same file Image > Variables > Data Sets > Import accepts).

Users often say: load data sets, import variables XML, data-driven graphics.

Use when: the template PSD already has variable-bound layers and you want to load rows from an XML file.
Do NOT use when: generating a batch from a CSV directly — use photoshop_recipe_csv_to_cards.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { count, datasets } }.
Preconditions: active document with variables defined (Image > Variables > Define).

xml_path.description: Absolute path to the variables/data-sets XML file

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_invert
entries.description: Invert colors of the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_invert_selection
entries.description: Invert the current selection

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_list_datasets
entries.description:
List the data sets defined on the active document (Image > Variables > Data Sets).

Use when: before applying data sets or debugging a data-driven template.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { datasets, active, count } }.
Preconditions: active document with variables/data sets defined.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_list_documents
entries.description:
List every open Photoshop document with id, dimensions, and which tab is active (read-only).

Use when: multiple documents are open and you need document_id before switching tabs or closing a specific file.
Do NOT use when: you only need the active document — use photoshop_get_document_info or photoshop_get_state.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { count, documents[], active_document_id, context } }.
Preconditions: none (safe when zero documents open). Side effects: none.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_list_fonts
entries.description:
List installed fonts available to Photoshop.

Use when: choosing a font for photoshop_create_text_layer or photoshop_set_text_font.
TextItem.font requires the PostScript name — use postScriptName from results, or pass display name to set/create tools (they resolve automatically).

Returns: fonts array ({ name, postScriptName, family, style }), total count, truncated flag.
First call may be slow (app.fonts.length can exceed 1000). Side effects: none.

query.description: Optional substring filter (matches name, postScriptName, or family)

limit.description: Maximum fonts to return (default: 200)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_merge_visible_layers
entries.description: Merge all visible layers into one

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer
entries.description: Move the active layer by specified offset

deltaX.description: Horizontal offset in pixels (can be negative)

deltaY.description: Vertical offset in pixels (can be negative)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer_down
entries.description: Move the active layer down one position in the layer stack

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer_to_bottom
entries.description: Move the active layer to the bottom of the layer stack

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer_to_position
entries.description: Move the active layer relative to another layer

targetLayerName.description: Name of the layer to move relative to

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer_to_top
entries.description: Move the active layer to the top of the layer stack

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_move_layer_up
entries.description: Move the active layer up one position in the layer stack

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_neural_filter
entries.description:
Apply a Photoshop Neural Filter via the companion UXP bridge plugin.

Use when: skin smoothing, harmonize composite layers, depth blur, super zoom, or colorizing B&W photos.
Do NOT use when: uxp_bridge_reachable is false — install uxp-plugin per docs/development.md.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: UXP bridge plugin running in Photoshop; PS 22+.

reference_layer_id.description: Layer id for harmonize reference (harmonize only)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_open_image
entries.description:
Open an image file as a new Photoshop document.

Use when: user provides a file path to edit or no document is open yet.
Do NOT use when: adding to an existing composite — use photoshop_place_image.

Returns: document id, name, width, height.
Preconditions: file must exist on disk. Side effects: opens document as active.

filePath.description: Full path to the image file

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_ping
entries.description:
Verify Photoshop is installed and reachable on this machine.

Use when: once at session start if connection status is unknown.
Do NOT use when: on every tool call — call once, then use photoshop_get_state.

Returns: connection success or failure message.
Preconditions: none. Side effects: may trigger Photoshop detection.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_place_image
entries.description:
Place an external image file as a new layer in the active document.

Use when: compositing assets into an open document at a specific offset.
Do NOT use when: opening a file as a new document — use photoshop_open_image.

Returns: placed layer name, bounds, and context.
Preconditions: active document; file must exist. Side effects: adds a new layer.

filePath.description: Full path to the image file (JPEG, PNG, PSD, etc.)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_play_action
entries.description: Play a recorded action from the Actions palette

actionName.description: Name of the action to play

actionSetName.description: Name of the action set containing the action

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_rasterize_layer
entries.description: Rasterize the active layer (convert text/smart object to normal layer)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_apply_color_grade
entries.description:
Apply a named color grading preset as a non-destructive layer group (Hue/Saturation adjustment + brightness/contrast tweak).

Users often say: cinematic look, teal and orange, moody grade, color grade.

Use when: the user wants a quick stylistic look applied to the active document.
Do NOT use when: the user wants subject-specific color edits (e.g. only the skin) — current recipe applies globally.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { preset, group_name } }.

Preconditions: active document in RGB mode. CMYK/Grayscale return unsupported_color_mode.
Side effects: adds one layer group with adjustment layers; one undo reverts.

preset.description: Preset name. One of: cinematic, vintage, teal_orange, bw, warm_film, cool_dusk. Default cinematic.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_batch_mockup_replace
entries.description:
Iterate a directory of asset images, replace the contents of the named Smart Object in the active mockup PSD for each asset, and export a flattened JPEG per variant. The mockup's perspective/warp on the Smart Object is preserved.

Use when: the user has a mockup PSD and wants to render it once per design asset (logos, screens, product photos).
Do NOT use when: the asset is not a single layer (use photoshop_place_image manually) or when the active document has no Smart Object with the requested name.

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths, details: { variants: [{ source_asset, output_path }] } }.

Preconditions: active document containing a Smart Object layer named exactly as requested; assets_dir must exist and be readable.
Side effects: writes one JPEG per asset; the active mockup PSD ends up with the LAST asset placed.

smart_object_layer_name.description: Exact name of the Smart Object layer in the active document. Case-sensitive.

assets_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing asset files. Subdirectories are NOT recursed. Allowed extensions: jpg/jpeg/png/tif/tiff/psd/psb/webp.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale. Default 10.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_batch_watermark
entries.description:
Apply a text or logo watermark to every image in a folder and export watermarked JPEGs. Replaces the clunky record-an-action + File > Automate > Batch workflow.

Use when: the user wants to watermark many photos at once (copyright text, studio logo).
Do NOT use when: watermarking a single open document (use photoshop_create_text_layer / photoshop_place_image directly) or removing watermarks (not supported).

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths, details: { processed, failed: [{ file, error }] } }. Files that fail are skipped, not fatal.

Preconditions: assets_dir exists; either text or logo_path given. No active document required.
Side effects: writes one JPEG per source image; source files are never modified.

assets_dir.description: Absolute path to the folder of images to watermark. Subdirectories are NOT recursed. Allowed extensions: jpg/jpeg/png/tif/tiff/webp.

text.description: Watermark text (e.g. "© Jane Doe 2026"). White, semi-transparent. Required unless logo_path is given.

logo_path.description: Absolute path to a logo image (transparent PNG recommended). Required unless text is given. If both are given, text wins.

margin_px.description: Distance from the chosen edge(s) in pixels. Default 24 (ignored for center).

font_size.description: Text watermark size in pixels. Default 0 = auto (4% of each image height, min 8px).

scale_pct.description: Logo watermark width as a percentage of image width (1-100). Default 15. Logo mode only.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale. Default 10.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_csv_to_cards
entries.description:
Data-driven graphics batch: convert a CSV file into Photoshop data sets, apply each row to the active template document and export one image per row. "Mail merge for images" — name cards, badges, certificates, personalized banners.

Users often say: csv to images, batch name cards, personalized banners, generate badges from spreadsheet, sertifika bastır.

CSV rules: first row = variable names matching the variables defined in the template PSD (Image > Variables > Define). A cell holding an absolute path to an image file (.png/.jpg/.webp/.tif/.psd) is treated as a pixel-replacement variable.

Use when: the user has a template PSD with variable-bound layers and a CSV of rows.
Do NOT use when: the document has no variables defined — define them in Photoshop first (Image > Variables > Define).

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { rows, exported, output_paths, xml_path } }.

Preconditions: active document with variable-bound layers; readable CSV file.
Side effects: writes a temp variables XML and one output file per row into output_dir.

csv_path.description: Absolute path to the CSV file (first row = variable names)

output_dir.description: Directory for generated files (created if missing)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_dodge_burn
entries.description:
One-shot dodge & burn setup: creates a 50% gray layer in Overlay or Soft Light mode for non-destructive light sculpting. Wrapped in a single undoable history step.

Users often say: dodge and burn, sculpt light, lighten face, darken shadows.

Use when: the user wants a ready-to-paint dodge & burn layer above the subject.
Do NOT use when: the user wants automated retouch — this only sets up the paint layer; paint white (dodge) and black (burn) manually at low opacity.
Do NOT use when: automated portrait smoothing is enough — use photoshop_recipe_enhance_portrait instead.

Returns: { ok, summary, undo_history_states_consumed, details: { layer_name, blend_mode } }.

Preconditions: active document with a raster-compatible active layer.
Side effects: adds one "Dodge & Burn" layer above the active layer; one undo reverts.

blend_mode.description: Retouch blend mode: overlay (default, stronger) or soft_light (gentler)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_enhance_portrait
entries.description:
Set up a non-destructive portrait enhancement: duplicates the active layer, builds a frequency separation pair (low/high) for skin smoothing, and adds an auto-tone curves adjustment on top. Grouped as "Enhance Portrait" and reversible with one undo.

Users often say: smooth skin, retouch portrait, fix blemishes, clean up face.

Use when: the user asks to "enhance", "retouch", "clean up" or "smooth" a portrait photo and is happy with a baseline that they can further tweak interactively.
Do NOT use when: the user wants destructive, final edits — recommend manual frequency separation work via photoshop_recipe_frequency_separation instead so they can paint by hand.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { intensity, radius_px, group_name } }.

Preconditions: active document with a NORMAL or background-converted raster layer.
Side effects: appends one layer group of 2-3 layers above the active layer; original layer untouched.

intensity.description: Retouch strength: low (subtle), medium (default), high (heavier smoothing).

skin_smoothing.description: Whether to build the frequency separation pair. When false, only the auto-tone curves are added.

use_neural_skin.description: Apply Neural Filter skin smoothing via UXP bridge before frequency separation (default false)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_export_social_variants
entries.description:
Render one JPEG per requested social-media platform from the active document. Each variant is center-cropped/resized to the platform spec and saved to disk.

Use when: the user wants multi-platform deliverables in one shot.
Do NOT use when: only one export is needed (use photoshop_recipe_prepare_for_web instead) or when platforms differ by content rather than crop (recipe does not change content, only frame).

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths, details: { variants } }.

Preconditions: active document. Aspect ratios that differ from the source result in a center-crop (no padding).
Side effects: writes one file per platform; source unchanged.

platforms.description: Slugs of platforms to export. Known: instagram_post, instagram_story, instagram_reel, x_post, x_header, facebook_post, facebook_cover, linkedin_post, linkedin_banner, youtube_thumbnail, tiktok_vertical, pinterest_pin. Default: instagram_post, instagram_story, x_post.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale. Default 9.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_frequency_separation
entries.description:
Build a frequency separation stack (Low + High) on top of the active layer for hands-on retouching. Does not apply any smoothing itself — the user paints into the layers afterwards.

Users often say: frequency separation, split texture and color, manual retouch setup.

Use when: the user explicitly wants frequency separation setup, typically for portrait or product retouching.
Do NOT use when: the user wants a one-shot result without painting — use photoshop_recipe_enhance_portrait instead.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { radius_px, group_name } }.

Preconditions: active document with a NORMAL raster active layer.
Side effects: appends a "Frequency Separation" layer group with 2 prepared layers; one undo reverts everything.

radius_px.description: Gaussian blur radius for the low-frequency layer. 4-8 for portraits, 10-20 for products. Default 6. Range 1-50.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_gradient_fade
entries.description:
One-shot gradient fade on the active layer mask: creates a reveal-all mask if needed, then paints a linear black-to-white gradient for soft edge blending. Wrapped in a single undoable history step.

Users often say: fade into background, gradient mask, blend subject, soft edge fade, arka planı yumuşat.

This applies a linear gradient on the layer mask channel — not a Gradient Fill layer.
Use when: the user wants the active layer to fade into the background or layers below through its mask.
Do NOT use when: the subject is not isolated — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background first.
Do NOT use when: replacing the sky with an external image — use photoshop_recipe_sky_blend.

Returns: { ok, summary, undo_history_states_consumed, details: { direction, start_pct, end_pct, mask_created, layer_name } }.

Preconditions: active document with an active layer.
Side effects: creates or modifies the active layer mask; one undo reverts everything.

direction.description: Gradient fade direction on the mask (default bottom_to_top)

angle_deg.description: Optional gradient angle override in degrees

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_organize_layers
entries.description:
Tidy the active document's layer stack: rename layers using a consistent scheme and optionally auto-group them by kind. Never deletes, merges or rasterizes — visual output stays identical.

Use when: the user complains about layer mess ("layer 1 copy 2", "untitled 7") or asks for organization.
Do NOT use when: the user wants smart, semantic naming based on layer content beyond text — recipe only summarizes text layers, not image content.

Returns: { ok, summary, details: { renamed_count, group_count } }.

Preconditions: active document.
Side effects: renames top-level layers and (optionally) moves them into kind-grouped folders; one undo reverts everything.

naming_scheme.description: How to rename layers: type_index (default, e.g. text_01), content_summary (text layers get a slug of their content; other kinds get type_index), preserve (do not rename).

auto_group.description: Group layers by kind (text / image / shape / adjustment). Default true.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_passport_photo
entries.description:
Turn the active portrait into a passport/ID photo: removes the background via Select Subject, replaces it with white, crops around the subject with ICAO-style headroom, resizes to the exact official pixel size at 300 DPI, and exports a JPEG. Optionally also builds a 10×15 cm print sheet with multiple copies.

Use when: passport photo, visa photo, ID photo, vesikalık, biyometrik fotoğraf.
Do NOT use when: the document has no clear single subject, or official compliance must be guaranteed — head-size rules are approximated from subject bounds (no face detection); official acceptance is NOT guaranteed.

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths, details: { spec, width, height, sheet } }.

Preconditions: PS ≥ 23 (Select Subject v2); active document with a single-person portrait.
Side effects: writes one JPEG (+ one sheet JPEG when make_sheet); source document is unchanged.

spec.description: Target size: us_2x2 (600×600 px), eu_35x45 (413×531 px), tr_50x60 (591×709 px). All at 300 DPI. Default us_2x2.

make_sheet.description: Also export a 10×15 cm (1200×1800 px @300 DPI) print sheet tiled with copies. Default false.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale. Default 11.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_prepare_for_web
entries.description:
Export a web-optimized version of the active document: duplicate, convert to sRGB, downscale longest edge, sharpen for screen, save to disk. The source PSD stays untouched.

Use when: the user wants a shareable JPEG/PNG sized for the web from the current artwork.
Do NOT use when: the user wants multiple platform-specific exports — use photoshop_recipe_export_social_variants. Do NOT call photoshop_save_document afterwards; this recipe already wrote the file.

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths, undo_history_states_consumed }.

Preconditions: active document. Format is jpeg (default) or png.
Side effects: writes one file to disk; the source document is unchanged.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale. Default 9. Ignored for png.

path.description: Optional output path. Absolute paths used as-is. Relative paths resolve under ~/.photoshop-mcp/exports[/<chat-id>]. Omit to auto-generate.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_remove_background
entries.description:
One-shot background removal: runs Select Subject on the active layer, inverts the selection, attaches a layer mask, and applies an optional feather. Wrapped in a single undoable history step.

Users often say: cut out, isolate subject, remove background, transparent background, arka planı sil.

Use when: the user wants the subject isolated from the background non-destructively. The source pixels are preserved behind the mask.
Do NOT use when: the subject is extremely fine-edged (hair against a busy background) — propose a manual Refine Edge pass afterwards.

Returns: { ok, summary, undo_history_states_consumed, details }. On failure, an error envelope with code and suggested_next_tool.

Preconditions: PS ≥ 23 (Select Subject v2). Active document with a non-background active layer that contains a subject.
Side effects: attaches a pixel mask to the active layer; no pixels destroyed; one undo reverts everything.

feather_px.description: Edge feather in pixels (0-20). 0 = hard edge (default for product shots), 1-3 = soft edge for portraits.

keep_shadow.description: Reserved for a future iteration; currently recorded in the response but no shadow layer is created yet.

use_generative.description: After masking, run generative edge cleanup on inverted background selection (default false)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_remove_distraction
entries.description:
One-shot distraction removal: generative AI remove when available, else content-aware fill. Wrapped in a single undoable history step.

Users often say: remove that person, erase distraction, content aware remove, clone out object.

Use when: the user has selected the object or region to remove.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — use photoshop_select_rectangle or photoshop_select_subject first.

Returns: { ok, summary, undo_history_states_consumed, details }.
Preconditions: active document with an active pixel selection.
Side effects: fills/removes selected pixels; clears selection.

feather_px.description: Edge feather in pixels before remove (0-20, default 0)

use_generative.description: Prefer generative remove when Photoshop supports it (default true when capable)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_sky_blend
entries.description:
One-shot sky composite: places an external sky image, adds a layer mask, and applies a horizon gradient fade. Wrapped in a single undoable history step.

Users often say: replace sky, fix blown sky, better clouds, swap sky background.

Use when: the user provides a sky image path and native sky replacement is unavailable or manual blend is preferred.
Do NOT use when: no sky_image_path is available — ask the user for an absolute file path first.
Do NOT use when: fading the active subject layer only — use photoshop_recipe_gradient_fade.

Returns: { ok, summary, undo_history_states_consumed, details: { sky_image_path, layer_name, horizon_pct, feather_pct, direction } }.

Preconditions: active document; sky image file must exist on disk.
Side effects: adds a placed sky layer with gradient mask; one undo reverts everything.

sky_image_path.description: Absolute path to the sky image file (JPEG, PNG, etc.)

horizon_pct.description: Document-height percentage where sky meets landscape (0-100, default 50)

feather_pct.description: Half-width of the transition zone around the horizon (0-50, default 15)

use_native_sky.description: Try native Sky Replacement first when supported (default true when capable)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_recipe_split_carousel
entries.description:
Split the active wide document into N equal vertical slices and export them as sequentially numbered files for a seamless Instagram/TikTok carousel (panorama swipe effect).

Use when: the user wants a seamless/swipeable carousel, split panorama, or multi-slide export of one wide design. Typical request: "split this into a 5-slide carousel".
Do NOT use when: the user wants the same content reframed per platform (use photoshop_recipe_export_social_variants) or a single crop (use photoshop_crop_document).

Returns: { ok, summary, output_paths (in slide order), details: { slides, slice_width } }.

Preconditions: active document whose width is at least `slides` pixels.
Side effects: writes one file per slide; source document is unchanged.

slides.description: Number of carousel slides to split into (2-10).

slide_width.description: Optional final slide width in px (e.g. 1080). Requires slide_height. Each slice is center-cropped/resized to this size. Omit to keep native slice dimensions.

slide_height.description: Optional final slide height in px (e.g. 1350 for Instagram portrait). Requires slide_width.

quality.description: JPEG quality on the Photoshop 1-12 scale (jpg only). Default 10.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_redo
entries.description: Redo the previously undone operation(s) - equivalent to Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_release_clipping_mask
entries.description:
Release (remove) the clipping mask from the active layer (or a named layer).

Users often say: unclip, release clipping mask, remove clipping mask.

Use when: a clipped layer should become independent again.
Do NOT use when: the layer is not clipped — returns not_clipping error.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, is_clipping: false } }.
Preconditions: active document; target layer must currently be a clipping mask (grouped).
Side effects: sets layer.grouped = false; one history step.

layer_name.description: Optional exact layer name (recursive search). Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_rename_layer
entries.description: Rename the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_replace_smart_object_contents
entries.description:
Replace the embedded contents of a Smart Object layer from an image file. Preserves transforms, warps, and Smart Filters on the layer.

Users often say: replace smart object, swap mockup screen, relink embedded file.

Use when: updating a mockup or template Smart Object with a new asset file.
Do NOT use when: the target is not a Smart Object — convert first or use photoshop_place_image.
Do NOT use for linked Smart Objects that need Relink to File — this replaces embedded contents.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { layer_name, file_path } }.
Preconditions: Smart Object layer active or named; file_path must exist (absolute). Side effects: replaces embedded pixels.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the replacement image file (JPEG, PNG, PSD, etc.)

layer_name.description: Optional exact Smart Object layer name. Default: active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_resize_image
entries.description: Resize the active image to specified dimensions

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_rotate_layer
entries.description: Rotate the active layer

degrees.description: Rotation angle in degrees (positive = clockwise, negative = counter-clockwise)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_save_document
entries.description:
Save the active document to disk in PSD, JPEG, or PNG format.

Use when: user requests export/save with a specific path and format.
Do NOT use when: web-optimized resize+sharpen pipeline is needed — use photoshop_recipe_prepare_for_web.

Returns: confirmation with saved path and format.
Preconditions: active document; path required. Side effects: writes file to disk.

path.description: Full path where to save the document

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_save_selection
entries.description:
Save the active pixel selection to a new alpha channel.

Use when: preserving a selection for later reload or batch workflows.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create one first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { channel_name, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: adds alpha channel.

channel_name.description: Optional name for the new alpha channel (auto-generated if omitted)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_scale_layer
entries.description: Scale the active layer by a percentage

centerAnchor.description: Scale from center (true) or top-left (false). Default: true

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_select_all
entries.description: Select the entire document

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_select_ellipse
entries.description:
Create an elliptical pixel selection from a bounding box (anti-aliased).

Use when: circular or oval masks, vignettes, or radial edits inside a region.
Do NOT use when: a rectangular region is enough — use photoshop_select_rectangle.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { shape, bounds?, context } }.
Preconditions: active document; right > left and bottom > top. Side effects: replaces current selection.

left.description: Left edge of bounding box in pixels

top.description: Top edge of bounding box in pixels

right.description: Right edge of bounding box in pixels

bottom.description: Bottom edge of bounding box in pixels

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_select_layer_by_name
entries.description:
Select the active layer by exact name, including layers inside groups.

Use when: a transform or property tool must target a named layer (photoshop_scale_layer, etc.).
Do NOT use when: the layer is already active — check photoshop_get_state first.

Returns: selected, layerName, kind, bounds (best-effort), context.
First depth-first name match wins when duplicate names exist in different groups.
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: changes active layer.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_select_rectangle
entries.description:
Create a rectangular pixel selection from corner coordinates.

Use when: masking, cropping a region, or preparing for layer mask.
Do NOT use when: subject isolation is needed — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background.

Returns: selection bounds [left, top, right, bottom].
Preconditions: active document. Side effects: replaces current selection.

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_select_subject
entries.description:
Run Select Subject on the active layer (creates a pixel selection only, no mask).

Users often say: cut out, isolate subject, select person, select object.

Use when: you need a subject selection for masking, fill, or further edits.
Do NOT use when: full background removal with mask — use photoshop_recipe_remove_background.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { selected, method } }.
Preconditions: PS ≥ 23, active document, non-Background active layer with a recognizable subject.
Side effects: replaces current selection.

sample_all_layers.description: Sample all layers for autoCutout fallback (default false)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_active_document
entries.description:
Switch the active document tab by document_id (preferred), zero-based index, or name.

Use when: working across multiple open files and mutations must target a specific document.
Do NOT use when: only one document is open — it is already active.
Do NOT use document_name when duplicate names exist — use document_id from photoshop_list_documents.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { activated: { id, name }, context } }.
Preconditions: target document must be open. Provide exactly one of document_id, index, or document_name. Side effects: changes active tab.

document_id.description: Unique internal document id from photoshop_list_documents (preferred)

index.description: Zero-based tab order index (leftmost tab is 0)

document_name.description: Document name/title (ambiguous if multiple tabs share the same name)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_layer_blend_mode
entries.description: Set the blend mode of the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_layer_locked
entries.description: Lock or unlock the active layer

locked.description: Whether the layer should be locked

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_layer_opacity
entries.description: Set the opacity of the active layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_layer_visibility
entries.description: Show or hide the active layer

visible.description: Whether the layer should be visible

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_text_alignment
entries.description: Set text alignment for active text layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_text_color
entries.description: Set color for active text layer

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_set_text_font
entries.description:
Set font family and size for active text layer.

Accepts display name (e.g. "Arial") or PostScript name (e.g. "ArialMT") — resolved via app.fonts.
Use photoshop_list_fonts to discover available fonts.

fontName.description: Font display or PostScript name (see photoshop_list_fonts)

entries.name: mcp__photoshop__photoshop_sky_replacement
entries.description:
Replace the sky using Photoshop native Sky Replacement when available.

Use when: a sky image path is provided and native AI sky replacement is supported.
Fallback: photoshop_recipe_sky_blend for manual composite.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: active document; optional sky_image_path for custom sky.

sky_image_path.description: Optional absolute path to a sky image file

entries.description: Update the text content of active text layer

content.text:
All 21 findings are handled: 20 with code changes and Finding 19 with no change, because a probe showed the failure can't happen. `dart analyze lib test` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings; the 36 info-level lints are all in files I didn't touch. `flutter test` passes 62/62. No git mutations. I deleted my probe and scratch files, and left the files that were already in the scratchpad alone.

## 1. What changed, per finding

- **F1 (settings import/reset flips login mode):** Importing settings (`storage.dart`) and "重置可导出的设置" (`about/view.dart`) now keep this device's current `loginMode`. A backup therefore can't switch it on or off. `MineController._onLogoutMain` no longer deletes the account unless login mode is on and `Accounts.main` is a `LoginAccount`. An anonymized request that answers "账号未登录" can't delete stored credentials any more.
- **F2 (missing account-only endpoints):** Added to `_accountApis`:
  - `Api.favResourceList` and `Api.mediaList`
  - `Api.setLiveFavTag`
  - `${appBaseUrl}/x/v2/account/myinfo`
  - `/x/member/app/{uname,sign,sex,birthday}/update`

  Each one has a test in `login_policy_test.dart`. I used no generic access_key rule, and `feedDislike` is untouched.
- **F3 (incognito badge follows the heartbeat role):** `anonymity` now comes only from `!loginMode`. I removed the three places that reset it from `heartbeat.isLogin`: `accounts.dart`, which also loses the now-unused `MineController` import, plus `login/controller.dart` and `about/view.dart`.
- **F4 (UP space always shows "not followed"):** In login mode, the space page now fetches `UserHttp.userRelation(mid)` (on the allowlist) when the space isn't your own. The relation shows `-10` for special follows, and blacklist status comes through the attribute.
- **F5 (live danmaku socket sends your uid):** The socket now always sends `uid: 0`, because its token is fetched anonymously.
- **F6 (WebView gets the full login cookies):**
  - New `LoginUtils.setAnonymousWebCookie()`. It deletes every stored account's cookies from the WebView and installs the anonymous jar. Startup (`init.dart`) and `onLoginMain` use it.
  - The "重置cookie" menu still installs the account's cookies, because it's an explicit user action.
  - Taking notes is treated as an account flow:
    - Non-Linux: the account's cookies go in before the page loads (the body waits for them) and are removed again when the page closes.
    - Linux: `openLinux` injects the account's cookies only for the note-app URL, and the anonymous jar everywhere else.
- **F7 (extras request bursts and the deletion race):**
  - Extras exports now run one at a time from a queue in `DownloadService`.
  - `DownloadExtras.export` takes a `cancelled` check, polled between steps, comment pages, reply pages and subtitles.
  - `deleteDownload` and `deletePage` cancel the export and wait for it if it's already running.
  - `CommentImages` creates its folder non-recursively, so it can't recreate a deleted video folder.
  - An export folder holding only `.part` files (left behind if the app was killed mid-merge) is reused instead of creating "name (2)". Folders a merge is writing into right now are excluded.
  - Self-test waits for the extras (5-minute cap) before it reports `folderFiles`.
  - The 200/10 comment defaults are unchanged.
- **F8 (416 truncation, retry budget):**
  - A 416 with no usable `Content-Range` now asks for the size with a 1-byte range request.
  - If the size still can't be found, the attempt fails without truncating the file.
  - Only consecutive attempts that save nothing count toward the 6-attempt budget, and the backoff follows that count.
- **F9 (merge guard shared across merges):** `_mergingCid` / `_mergeDeleted` became per-entry sets: `_mergingCids` and `_mergeDeletedCids`.
- **F10 (old-format merge picks segments from disk):** The segment count now comes from `index.json`'s `segment_list`. Higher-numbered leftover segments are deleted. If `index.json` can't be read, the old probing is the fallback.
- **F11 (multi-segment fallback):**
  - Any remux/join error, not only `UnsupportedError`, now falls back to keeping the segments.
  - Each part's extension comes from its content (flv, mp4, ts, else `.bin`), including the single-file case.
  - Android media-scans every part, not just the first.
  - A toast says when segments are saved separately.
  - Merge failure sets `DownloadStatus.failMerge`.
  - In-app playback of the separate parts is untouched (deferred).
- **F12 (live room, logged out):** The input bar now shows when you're logged out. It keeps the danmaku toggle and hides like and send.
- **F13 (file paths as launch arguments):** The link stream now opens existing local paths and `file:` URIs as files instead of routing them. It skips the file `main()` already opened (`PiliScheme.launchFile`) and the app's own executable path.
- **F14 (XML danmaku from other tools):**
  - `<base>.xml` is used when `<base>.danmaku.xml` doesn't exist.
  - The parser accepts other attributes, `p=` anywhere in the tag, and single quotes.
  - Numeric entities are decoded in a single pass.
  - Test added.
- **F15 (local feed refetches everyone):** Uploads are cached per UP for the session (30 minutes). Opening the tab or following/unfollowing someone fetches only uncached or stale UPs. Pull-to-refresh still fetches everyone.
- **F16 (self-test isolation):** The self-test uses its own temp subfolder on every platform. On Linux, `--selftest` sets `G_APPLICATION_NON_UNIQUE`, so it runs as its own instance instead of being forwarded.
- **F17 (heartbeats for local playback):** `makeHeartBeat` returns early for any file source, which covers offline downloads and plain local files.
- **F18 (favourites panel):** If the account folders fail to load, the local folders still show above the error. "完成" then saves only the local choice and closes.
- **F19 (Windows long paths):** No change. A real Dart probe wrote, renamed and listed a 309-character path successfully, then cleaned up. `dart.exe` has no `longPathAware` manifest, so the machine's `LongPathsEnabled=1` setting didn't apply to the probe. dart:io adds the `\\?\` prefix itself, so the failure can't happen there.
- **F20 (library import clears before checking):** New `LocalLibrary.checkImport`. It parses every entry with the same parsers the app uses, and throws before anything is cleared. It runs both inside `importAll` and before settings import touches any box.
- **F21 (update dialog):** Removed the Windows "exe" button; only "zip" remains.

## 2. `git diff`

The full diff is 1,567 lines, too long to paste here. It's saved at `C:\Users\Z14\.claude\projects\C--Users-Z14-Documents-Coding-Piliplus\b3582635-083d-4d21-a877-4ec6aedfc636\tool-results\bw7pyal6w.txt`. It's identical to `git diff -- lib linux test` on the working tree now; please give that exact output to the re-review.

Files touched:
- `lib/http/init.dart`
- `lib/main.dart`
- `lib/pages/{about/view, danmaku/controller, fav_panel/view, live_room/controller, live_room/view, local/feed, login/controller, member/controller, mine/controller, webview/view}.dart`
- `lib/plugin/pl_player/controller.dart`
- `lib/services/download/{download_extras, download_manager, download_service}.dart`
- `lib/services/local_library.dart`
- `lib/utils/{accounts, accounts/login_policy, app_scheme, login_utils, path_utils, self_test, storage, update}.dart`
- `linux/runner/my_application.cc`
- `test/utils/{download_extras_test, login_policy_test}.dart`

`audit-logs/route-pending.md` shows as modified, but that edit isn't mine.

## 3. Uncertainties

- **F1:**
  - I chose to keep the current login mode rather than re-apply accounts after import. As a result, a backup's `loginMode` is never restored.
  - `hideInteraction` from an import only takes effect on screens built afterwards.
- **F2:**
  - `favResourceList` and `mediaList` now carry the account in login mode for every folder, including other users' public folders. The alternative in the finding was matching your own folder ids.
  - The server error codes are unverified; nothing was sent to the network.
- **F4:** "被关注" (`isFollowed`) still comes from the anonymous space data.
- **F6:**
  - The note flow is my reading of "explicit account flow". If the note page is closed abnormally, its cookies stay until the next start or login.
  - After "重置cookie", the account's cookies remain in the WebView until the next start or login.
  - Linux has no step to delete old cookies, because `setAnonymousWebCookie` returns early on Linux.
- **F7:** A cancelled export can still finish the one request or image download it's in the middle of before it stops.
- **F8:** On a CDN that answers the 1-byte probe without a size, a finished segment now fails after 6 attempts with its bytes kept, where before it was truncated and downloaded again.
- **F11:**
  - Content that's neither flv, mp4 nor ts is now saved as `.bin`, which galleries won't play.
  - `failMerge` is set only in memory; entry status isn't saved to disk.
- **F13:**
  - What package:gtk actually delivers is unverified. I can't run Linux here.
  - The `.desktop` file (`%u`, no video MIME types) is unchanged.
- **F14:** A `data-p=` attribute would also match, which is harmless.
- **F16:** `my_application.cc` is not compiled or tested here (no Linux toolchain).
- **F17:** I turned off heartbeats for all offline playback, not just `cid == 0`. Watching downloads in login mode no longer syncs history.
- **F18:** I also changed "完成" to skip the account request when the account folders failed to load. The finding didn't explicitly ask for that.

- **F2 (missing account-only endpoints):** Added to `_accountApis`:

  - `Api.setLiveFavTag`
  - `${appBaseUrl}/x/v2/account/myinfo`
  - `/x/member/app/{uname,sign,sex,birthday}/update`

  Each one has a test in `login_policy_test.dart`. I used no generic access_key rule, and `feedDislike` is untouched.
- **F3 (incognito badge follows the heartbeat role):** `anonymity` now comes only from `!loginMode`. I removed the three places that reset it from `heartbeat.isLogin`: `accounts.dart`, which also loses the now-unused `MineController` import, plus `login/controller.dart` and `about/view.dart`.
- **F4 (UP space always shows "not followed"):** In login mode, the space page now fetches `UserHttp.userRelation(mid)` (on the allowlist) when the space isn't your own. The relation shows `-10` for special follows, and blacklist status comes through the attribute.
- **F5 (live danmaku socket sends your uid):** The socket now always sends `uid: 0`, because its token is fetched anonymously.
- **F6 (WebView gets the full login cookies):**
  - New `LoginUtils.setAnonymousWebCookie()`. It deletes every stored account's cookies from the WebView and installs the anonymous jar. Startup (`init.dart`) and `onLoginMain` use it.
  - The "重置cookie" menu still installs the account's cookies, because it's an explicit user action.
  - Taking notes is treated as an account flow:
    - Non-Linux: the account's cookies go in before the page loads (the body waits for them) and are removed again when the page closes.
    - Linux: `openLinux` injects the account's cookies only for the note-app URL, and the anonymous jar everywhere else.
- **F7 (extras request bursts and the deletion race):**
  - Extras exports now run one at a time from a queue in `DownloadService`.
  - `DownloadExtras.export` takes a `cancelled` check, polled between steps, comment pages, reply pages and subtitles.
  - `deleteDownload` and `deletePage` cancel the export and wait for it if it's already running.
  - `CommentImages` creates its folder non-recursively, so it can't recreate a deleted video folder.
  - An export folder holding only `.part` files (left behind if the app was killed mid-merge) is reused instead of creating "name (2)". Folders a merge is writing into right now are excluded.
  - Self-test waits for the extras (5-minute cap) before it reports `folderFiles`.
  - The 200/10 comment defaults are unchanged.
- **F8 (416 truncation, retry budget):**
  - A 416 with no usable `Content-Range` now asks for the size with a 1-byte range request.
  - If the size still can't be found, the attempt fails without truncating the file.
  - Only consecutive attempts that save nothing count toward the 6-attempt budget, and the backoff follows that count.
- **F9 (merge guard shared across merges):** `_mergingCid` / `_mergeDeleted` became per-entry sets: `_mergingCids` and `_mergeDeletedCids`.
- **F10 (old-format merge picks segments from disk):** The segment count now comes from `index.json`'s `segment_list`. Higher-numbered leftover segments are deleted. If `index.json` can't be read, the old probing is the fallback.
- **F11 (multi-segment fallback):**
  - Any remux/join error, not only `UnsupportedError`, now falls back to keeping the segments.
  - Each part's extension comes from its content (flv, mp4, ts, else `.bin`), including the single-file case.
  - Android media-scans every part, not just the first.
  - A toast says when segments are saved separately.
  - Merge failure sets `DownloadStatus.failMerge`.
  - In-app playback of the separate parts is untouched (deferred).
- **F12 (live room, logged out):** The input bar now shows when you're logged out. It keeps the danmaku toggle and hides like and send.
- **F13 (file paths as launch arguments):** The link stream now opens existing local paths and `file:` URIs as files instead of routing them. It skips the file `main()` already opened (`PiliScheme.launchFile`) and the app's own executable path.
- **F14 (XML danmaku from other tools):**
  - `<base>.xml` is used when `<base>.danmaku.xml` doesn't exist.
  - The parser accepts other attributes, `p=` anywhere in the tag, and single quotes.
  - Numeric entities are decoded in a single pass.
  - Test added.
- **F15 (local feed refetches everyone):** Uploads are cached per UP for the session (30 minutes). Opening the tab or following/unfollowing someone fetches only uncached or stale UPs. Pull-to-refresh still fetches everyone.
- **F16 (self-test isolation):** The self-test uses its own temp subfolder on every platform. On Linux, `--selftest` sets `G_APPLICATION_NON_UNIQUE`, so it runs as its own instance instead of being forwarded.
- **F17 (heartbeats for local playback):** `makeHeartBeat` returns early for any file source, which covers offline downloads and plain local files.
- **F18 (favourites panel):** If the account folders fail to load, the local folders still show above the error. "完成" then saves only the local choice and closes.
- **F19 (Windows long paths):** No change. A real Dart probe wrote, renamed and listed a 309-character path successfully, then cleaned up. `dart.exe` has no `longPathAware` manifest, so the machine's `LongPathsEnabled=1` setting didn't apply to the probe. dart:io adds the `\\?\` prefix itself, so the failure can't happen there.
- **F20 (library import clears before checking):** New `LocalLibrary.checkImport`. It parses every entry with the same parsers the app uses, and throws before anything is cleared. It runs both inside `importAll` and before settings import touches any box.
- **F21 (update dialog):** Removed the Windows "exe" button; only "zip" remains.

- `lib/plugin/pl_player/controller.dart`

- `lib/services/local_library.dart`
- `lib/utils/{accounts, accounts/login_policy, app_scheme, login_utils, path_utils, self_test, storage, update}.dart`
- `linux/runner/my_application.cc`
- `test/utils/{download_extras_test, login_policy_test}.dart`

`audit-logs/route-pending.md` shows as modified, but that edit isn't mine.

## 3. Uncertainties

- **F1:**
  - I chose to keep the current login mode rather than re-apply accounts after import. As a result, a backup's `loginMode` is never restored.
  - `hideInteraction` from an import only takes effect on screens built afterwards.
- **F2:**
  - `favResourceList` and `mediaList` now carry the account in login mode for every folder, including other users' public folders. The alternative in the finding was matching your own folder ids.
  - The server error codes are unverified; nothing was sent to the network.
- **F4:** "被关注" (`isFollowed`) still comes from the anonymous space data.
- **F6:**
  - The note flow is my reading of "explicit account flow". If the note page is closed abnormally, its cookies stay until the next start or login.
  - After "重置cookie", the account's cookies remain in the WebView until the next start or login.
  - Linux has no step to delete old cookies, because `setAnonymousWebCookie` returns early on Linux.
- **F7:** A cancelled export can still finish the one request or image download it's in the middle of before it stops.
- **F8:** On a CDN that answers the 1-byte probe without a size, a finished segment now fails after 6 attempts with its bytes kept, where before it was truncated and downloaded again.
- **F11:**
  - Content that's neither flv, mp4 nor ts is now saved as `.bin`, which galleries won't play.
  - `failMerge` is set only in memory; entry status isn't saved to disk.
- **F13:**
  - What package:gtk actually delivers is unverified. I can't run Linux here.
  - The `.desktop` file (`%u`, no video MIME types) is unchanged.
- **F14:** A `data-p=` attribute would also match, which is harmless.
- **F16:** `my_application.cc` is not compiled or tested here (no Linux toolchain).
- **F17:** I turned off heartbeats for all offline playback, not just `cid == 0`. Watching downloads in login mode no longer syncs history.
- **F18:** I also changed "完成" to skip the account request when the account folders failed to load. The finding didn't explicitly ask for that.
